Biobeat

BB-613WP Wrist Monitor

Cuffless continuous monitoring on the wrist — BP, SpO₂, heart rate, HRV, and cardiac output.

FDA Cleared Cuffless BP

The Biobeat BB-613WP wrist monitor delivers cuffless multiparameter vitals for patients who need continuous wearable monitoring without a traditional arm cuff.

What It Measures

  • Cuffless Blood Pressure
  • SpO₂
  • Heart Rate
  • HRV
  • Cardiac Output (CO)

Key Specifications

  • Wrist-worn cuffless monitoring form factor
  • Continuous multiparameter vital tracking
  • Bluetooth connectivity to monitoring platform
  • Clinical-grade wearable design
  • Suitable for outpatient and home pathways

Clearance & Focus

  • FDA Cleared
  • Cuffless ambulatory BP support
  • Continuous wearable vital trends
  • Pairs with remote care teams

A strong fit for continuous cuffless BP monitoring. Our clinical team can recommend wear duration and care plan integration.
